profile.name: Thobane Sithole
profile.headline: I build Java back-ends that stay calm when the traffic doesn't.
profile.availability: Open to graduate and junior developer roles
about: I'm a Java developer who likes the parts of a system most people never see: the services, the events moving between them, and the tests that prove they still work after Friday's deploy.

I trained through the Geeks4Learning learnership and work in a Scrum team, picking up Jira tickets, clarifying requirements with my tech lead before I write a line, and shipping in small, reviewable pieces.
My day-to-day stack is Java 21, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Docker and Kubernetes, with JUnit and Mockito keeping me honest.
profile.principle: If I can't explain why a line of code exists, it doesn't get merged.

projects.title: INTELLA
projects.summary: A full-stack web app, containerised and deployed end to end.

projects.title: Payment events service
projects.summary: Spring Boot microservices that talk through events instead of blocking REST calls.

projects.title: Task tracker API
projects.summary: A REST API with validation, paging and a full JUnit and Mockito test suite.

projects.title: This portfolio

services.title: Back-end services
services.promise: APIs that do one job well.
services.detail: REST endpoints in Spring Boot with validation, clear error responses and sensible layering.

services.title: Event-driven design
services.promise: Services that don't wait on each other.
services.detail: Publishing and consuming events so one slow service doesn't take the rest down with it.

services.title: Data and persistence
services.promise: Schemas that survive the second feature.
services.detail: PostgreSQL modelling, JPA mappings and queries that stay fast as the tables grow.

services.title: Testing and delivery
services.promise: Proof it works before it ships.
services.detail: Unit tests with JUnit and Mockito, containerised builds with Docker and deploys to Kubernetes.

process.title: Read the ticket
process.promise: Understand the ask before touching code.
process.detail: I pick up the Jira ticket and note what's clear, what's assumed and what's missing.

process.title: Clarify
process.detail: Anything unclear goes to the tech lead early, in stand-up or straight after it.

process.title: Design
process.detail: Which services, which tables, which events, and what could break.

process.title: Build and test
process.detail: Code and JUnit tests together, with Mockito to keep each unit isolated.

process.title: Review
process.detail: A focused pull request that explains why, not only what.

process.title: Ship
process.detail: Built into a container, deployed, and verified against the ticket's acceptance criteria.
